rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The project figures every worksheet line: line 6 (line 4 less line 5) also when line 4 is not more than line 5, where the worksheet skips it, and the worksheet lines for a married filer filing separately, who cannot take the deduction. Line 8 uses line 6 only when line 4 is more than line 5, and the deduction (sli.deduction, which Schedule 1 line 21 copies) is zero for a married filer filing separately; on every case the model and the project agree on the deduction.
